# Performance Energy

Skin ID: `performance-energy`

Public name: Performance Energy

Mood: bold, active, confident, energetic, practical.

Best-fit niches: fitness, fat-loss habits, strength, habit/performance, active lifestyle.

Visual metaphor: a premium movement/progress coaching website.

Structure:
- Hero: action-oriented with dynamic accents.
- Background: grid glow and motion-line CSS field.
- Cards: strong action cards with progress motif.
- CTA: bold high-contrast action CTA.
- Navbar: compact bold nav.
- Sticky CTA: action bar.
- Bonus: toolkit/action-resource cards.
- FAQ: bold accordion panels.
- Media: strong action frame.
- Motion: quick controlled snap and card lift.
- Mobile: remove diagonal overflow risk, keep compact power.

Difference from default: dynamic rhythm, action cards, grid glow, bold CTA/sticky bar, performance-focused visual grammar.

Must not change: no body-shaming or fake results; CTA href, legal/support, analytics, bonus service names, FAQ data, inspect slot keys stay canonical.
